text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the "Breeders' Cup," it's the 
festival of Umamusume racing held in 
America.

A dream stage where GⅠ races across 
various categories are held over two days 
at a single venue, bringing together elite 
Umamusume from all over the world.

Many Japanese Umamusume have challenged it 
in the past, but not a single one has ever 
achieved victory in any category...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

isn't it? It has a whole festive 
atmosphere unlike anything else.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

races, and the people who raised those 
Umamusume all gathering together to watch 
tons of incredible races—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

from all over the world... I hope that I 
can stand there one day too.
